   - Use `FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK | FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TASK` to clear the back stack so the user lands on the main screen
   - Show a `Toast` message explaining the theme was updated
   - Finish the Preferences activity last (so it closes cleanly after the main activity is launched)

2. **`strings.xml`** — Added a new string resource:
   ```xml
   <string name="pref_theme_restart_message">Theme updated. Returning to main screen.</string>
   ```

This addresses both options from the bug report: the user now sees the main `GpsTestActivity` after changing the theme, AND an informational message explains what happened.
